project.name: slm-2
project.objective: Implement a verifiable ADR data-labeling and decision workflow for the SLM project

lifecycle.next_action: Update requirement-linked tasks, then run genesis plan check.

assumptions.text: Claude Sonnet rewrites and decompositions represent valid candidate training signals following Noman 22-rule cold email framework.

invariants.text: Raw source data files in data/ and ADR files in ADRs/ are immutable; all derived labels and decisions must be written to separate derived artifacts.
Every derived label and decision record must reference its source record ID, source file path, and source SHA256 content hash.

decisions.title: Label Taxonomy Scope
decisions.text: Derived labels are strictly 4 fields: pain_point, personalization_angle, subject, and body, generated by Claude teacher before human review.

decisions.title: Reviewer Identity and Workflow
decisions.text: Sole human reviewer is Diwas; state machine transitions: proposed -> needs-review -> accepted / rejected / revised / uncertain.

decisions.title: Downstream Training Export
decisions.text: Downstream SLM dataset export format is JSONL containing 100% of validated records with verifiable partition integrity.

knowledge.title: Existing Dataset Inventory
knowledge.text: Existing raw dataset consists of 48 leads: 34 marketing leads in data/markeiting.json and 14 accounting leads in data/accounting.json with scraped context and historical sent emails.

tasks.outcome: Produce an approved, implementation-ready product specification
tasks.next_action: Interview the human, record durable context, and replace every placeholder in SPEC.md.

tasks.outcome: Implement JSON schemas and validators for label taxonomy and decisions
Implement ADR and raw source data ingestion with deterministic SHA-256 record hashing and immutable source verification
Implement Claude teacher candidate label generation interface, schema checking, and raw trace preservation
Implement decision state machine engine, state transition enforcement, and stale detection on source changes
Implement single-reviewer interactive CLI for Diwas to inspect candidates, record decisions, apply edits, and track rationales
Implement downstream SLM JSONL export generator for 100% of accepted/revised records with end-to-end provenance traces
Implement dataset isolation, partition verification, deduplication, and leakage prevention audit checks
Implement idempotency verification, interruption recovery, and resume without duplicate decisions
Document end-to-end ADR data-labeling and decision workflow, CLI guides, and example walkthrough

controls.reason: Approved decision state engine with verified external Claude candidate dataset
Approved review CLI with LinkedIn and website contact link display

checkpoint.next_action: Review completed work and choose the next bounded outcome.
